findings.issue: The module text and docstrings at lines 19, 28, 50, 60, 160, 173, 191, 208, 227, 255, 295, 339, and 377 call `U ∩ sphere ζ ρ` an arc/crosscut with ends and two sides. summary: The documentation repeatedly describes an arbitrary circle intersection as a crosscut arc that splits a domain into two sides, although the generalized declarations impose no separation or arc hypotheses.
